headline: Second quiet day in a row; the board stays frozen
body: Another completely quiet day. No events were scored and no earlier stories were fading yet, so every ending and world factor held still for a second day running. With no fresh news to push back, the darker tilt from the Pentagon's classified-network AI deals stays in place, and Enslaved God keeps the top spot. Horizon Balance remains +1.18.
movers_note: No movers today: every ending's change was 0.0.
